source.title: Aeva Adopts Cadence Tensilica Vision DSP to Advance Lidar Performance and Efficiency

facts: Cadence independently states that Aeva licensed Cadence Tensilica Vision DSP IP for signal processing in Aeva 4D LiDAR systems.

Cadence characterizes the licensing as a design win and says the DSP enables programmability, performance, low-power operation, scalability and customization for real-time lidar processing across automotive and industrial robotics applications.
limitations: This evidence does not establish OEM PPAP, homologation, purchase volume, realized revenue, series-production acceptance, or production ramp.
No score, underwriting conclusion, adjudication, or Alpha authority is asserted.
